Description
This newly designed
PAMP Suisse
Gold Bar contains 5 grams of 999.9% fine Gold and is manufactured in Switzerland. Lakshmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, love, prosperity, fortune, and the embodiment of beauty. Her four hands represent the four goals of human life considered proper in the Hindu way of life – dharma, kama, artha, and moksha. Archaeological discoveries and ancient coins suggest the recognition and reverence for goddess Lakshmi. Lakshmi’s iconography and statues have been found in Hindu temples of Southeast Asia, estimated to be from the second half of the 1st millennium AD. Today, Lakshmi is worshiped as the goddess of wealth. The festivals of Diwali and Sharad Purnima are celebrated in her honor. The reverse side of this exquisite coin features a detailed rendering of Lakshmi with diagonal lines behind her. This bar is packaged in its original assay card which guarantees the Gold metal weight and purity.
